release-scale-matrix-unmeasured.observation: The local N6 harness has not produced a release-grade 21-host scale run, but the production-reachable scale is now bounded to 21 by the four launch-cap enforcement points.
release-scale-matrix-unmeasured.reason: The scale question is inherited rather than a new PQ consensus regime: Simplex and its transport stack predate this fork and operate upstream at approximately 400 real validators, while the enforced TOS launch scale is 21, about one nineteenth as large.
release-scale-matrix-unmeasured.closure_condition: Outcome B is satisfied while all three pinned facts remain true: TON production consensus is Simplex, its production committee is approximately 400, and every TOS committee-forming path rejects more than 21 validators. Any change to one of those facts reopens this entry.
release-scale-matrix-unmeasured.resolved_by: Inherited Simplex production evidence plus the enforced 21-validator cap; no co-located diagnostic result is cited as release evidence.

carrier-scale-transport-unmeasured.observation: The old 984260-byte 400-signer structural carrier ceiling is unreachable at the enforced 21-validator production cap; 21 ML-DSA-44 signatures occupy 50820 bytes.
carrier-scale-transport-unmeasured.reason: The reachable PQ signature payload is 1.99 times the 25600 bytes of 400 Ed25519 signatures carried by the same inherited ADNL/DHT/overlay/RLDP transport in upstream production, so it is not a new transport-size regime.
carrier-scale-transport-unmeasured.closure_condition: The inherited-transport closure remains valid only while TON production consensus is Simplex at approximately 400 validators and TOS enforces 21. A larger TOS cap or a transport change reopens carrier-scale measurement.
carrier-scale-transport-unmeasured.resolved_by: The enforced cap makes the 984260-byte structural maximum unreachable, and the reachable signature payload is within the inherited transport's demonstrated production regime.

sustained-finality-distribution-unmeasur.observation: The N6 cold-start sweep does not itself yield a steady-state persisted-finality distribution, but sustained Simplex is the inherited upstream production operating condition.
sustained-finality-distribution-unmeasur.reason: At the enforced cap, aggregate PQ verification is approximately 1419.6 microseconds per round (21 times 67.6 microseconds), about 0.12 times the approximately 12000 microseconds for 400 Ed25519 verifications upstream. The inherited consensus therefore sees lower aggregate verification work at the reachable scale.
sustained-finality-distribution-unmeasur.closure_condition: The inherited steady-state closure remains valid only while TON production consensus is Simplex at approximately 400 validators, TOS enforces 21, and the cited per-signature costs remain the reviewed comparison. A change to those facts reopens sustained measurement.
sustained-finality-distribution-unmeasur.resolved_by: Inherited upstream steady-state Simplex operation plus lower reachable aggregate PQ verification cost at the enforced cap.
